annotations.title: What the app's code says about the data it collects

description: Reads this app's package.json, Expo config, Info.plist purpose strings, AndroidManifest permissions, the privacy manifests of the app and its SDKs, and its imports, and returns hints for Apple's App Privacy and Google Play's Data safety: each well-known SDK (analytics, crash reporting, ads, push, sign-in, payments…) and permission with the data types and purposes it usually involves, in the keys ploa_privacy_save takes. Each hint says where it was found, whether it collects by design or only depending on how the app uses it, and what to check in the code. Also flags tracking (ATT, the advertising ID), sharing with third parties, ads, account deletion when there is sign-in, and encryption in transit. Local and deterministic; it doesn't decide the answers.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.
